personal.name: Abdullah Ibne Tayeb Tamur
personal.subtitle: AI Researcher | Medical AI | XAI | Multimodal Clinical AI | Federated Learning
personal.tagline: Architecting Intelligence That Heals: From Stethoscopes to Silicon.

about.narrative: First author of three peer-reviewed conference papers and co-author of two additional peer-reviewed conference papers, with further medical AI manuscripts under review. Recent work includes CHD-Net (Best Presenter Award, IEEE QPAIN 2026), CMA-Fusion accepted at ICCA 2026, and HemX evaluated on 13,823 patient records under review at Biomedical Signal Processing and Control. Research focuses on clinically useful, interpretable, and validated AI systems for medical imaging, clinical triage, multimodal healthcare data, and decision support.

publications.title: HemX: Hierarchical XAI for Hematological Triage
publications.venue: Under Review — Biomedical Signal Processing and Control (Elsevier)
publications.description: Explainable hematological triage framework evaluated on 13,823 patient records. Integrates global SHAP, patient-level LIME, and the Hematological Heterogeneity Index (HHI) as an engineered biomarker. Evaluated using TRIPOD+AI-guided reporting and stratified 5-fold cross-validation.

publications.title: Fed-NeuroTriage: Federated Distillation Architecture for Psychiatric NLP
publications.description: Privacy-aware federated learning framework for psychiatric NLP triage using MIMIC-IV discharge summaries. Addresses severe class imbalance through knowledge distillation and inverse-frequency weighting.

publications.title: Cross Modality Attention for Leakage-Free Alzheimer's Disease Detection Using 3D MRI and Clinical Biomarkers
publications.description: Cross-modality attention framework for Alzheimer's disease detection using 3D MRI and clinical biomarkers. Focuses on leakage-free experimental design, multimodal feature integration, and clinically relevant decision-support modeling for neurodegenerative disease detection.

publications.title: DiaXAI-Stack: An Explainable AI Framework for Diabetes Prediction Using Leakage-Free Stacking Ensemble Learning
publications.authors: Abdullah Ibne Tayeb Tamur (Fifth Author & Research Mentor)
publications.description: Explainable AI framework for diabetes prediction using leakage-free stacking ensemble learning and dual threshold optimization. Contributed as research mentor: dataset preprocessing, SHAP/LIME integration for clinical transparency, experimental design, and manuscript development.

publications.title: CHD-Net: An Explainable Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Congenital Heart Disease Classification
publications.description: Explainable ensemble framework for pediatric CHD classification from echocardiography images. Achieved 99.15% accuracy and 99.99% AUC on 4,140 images via stratified 5-fold cross-validation. SHAP GradientExplainer applied for anatomical localisation of IAS, IVS, and ductus arteriosus regions.

publications.title: Dual-Stream FreqViT: FFT and Vision Transformer Fusion for Robust Plant Disease Detection
publications.description: Dual-stream architecture combining a spatial CNN branch, 2D FFT spectral branch, and Transformer encoder fusion. Achieved 97.75% accuracy under challenging field-lighting conditions.

publications.title: FUSE SENet: Fusion with SE Attention Network for Robust Skin Lesion Classification
publications.description: Fusion-based feature learning with squeeze-and-excitation (SE) attention for robust skin lesion classification.

projects.title: HemoForge — Explainable Hematology Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack explainable CBC analysis platform with SHAP, LangGraph workflow, OCR ingestion, and a Doctor/Patient LLM assistant.
projects.description: HemoForge is a full-stack explainable hematology engineering platform integrating a 9-class HistGradientBoosting model, SHAP explanations, out-of-distribution (OOD) assessment, selective review indicators, and a 10-node LangGraph workflow with LangSmith tracing.
projects.details: HemoParse supports human-verified PDF/image CBC extraction using PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, Tesseract OCR, and Groq LLM fallback. FastAPI, Next.js/TypeScript, and SQLite power the API, interface, case archive, and audit trail. Being extended with HemoAssist — a Doctor/Patient LLM assistant for plain-language report explanation, model-result interpretation, and controlled scholarly-literature retrieval.

projects.title: HemaTriage
projects.shortDescription: Clinical web application based on the HemX architecture for CPU-only hematological triage in resource-constrained healthcare settings.
projects.description: HemaTriage is a clinical web application built on the HemX architecture, designed for CPU-only hematological triage inference in resource-constrained healthcare settings. It enables real-world clinical deployment without requiring GPU hardware.
projects.details: The system ingests Complete Blood Count (CBC) parameters — WBC, RBC, Hemoglobin, Platelets, Neutrophils, Lymphocytes — and runs inference through a trained XGBoost + neural ensemble model based on the HemX research framework. XAI explanations via LIME are provided per-patient, showing which blood markers drove the triage decision. Built for low-resource clinics in South Asia.

projects.title: Customer Support Agent
projects.shortDescription: LangGraph + Groq (Llama 3.3 70B) agent with six domain tools, human-in-the-loop approval, guardrails, and LangSmith observability.
projects.description: A production-grade customer support agent built with LangGraph and Groq (Llama 3.3 70B). Features triage classification, six domain-specific tools, input/output guardrails, human-in-the-loop approval, short-term memory, LangSmith observability, and SQLite persistence.
projects.details: The agent orchestrates triage classification, routes queries to six specialized domain tools, applies input and output guardrails for safety, and supports human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive actions. LangSmith provides full observability and tracing. Short-term session memory and SQLite ensure conversation continuity and audit logging.

projects.title: SpectraLeaf Analytics
projects.shortDescription: Cloud-deployed plant disease detection using FFT + Vision Transformer dual-stream fusion.
projects.description: SpectraLeaf Analytics is a cloud-deployed plant disease detection application that combines spatial CNN features with FFT-based spectral representations for robust inference under challenging field lighting conditions.
projects.details: Based on the Dual-Stream FreqViT architecture (IEEE QPAIN 2026), the app processes leaf images through two parallel streams: a spatial CNN extracting texture features and a 2D FFT branch encoding frequency-domain disease signatures. Both are fused via a Transformer encoder. Achieves 97.75% accuracy across diverse field conditions. Deployed on Render cloud with Flask backend.

projects.title: Wolf Scholar
projects.shortDescription: Multimodal RAG research assistant using LangChain, FAISS, and Groq LLM for multi-document medical analysis.
projects.description: Wolf Scholar is an autonomous multimodal RAG-based research assistant that uses LangChain orchestration, FAISS vector database, and Groq-accelerated LLM inference for multi-document analysis and medical vision research workflows.
projects.details: The system ingests multiple PDFs (research papers, clinical guidelines), chunks and embeds them into a FAISS vector store, then answers complex queries with cited references. Supports image-based medical inputs for diagnostic workflows. Built with an agent loop that autonomously plans retrieval strategies, cross-references documents, and synthesizes multi-hop answers.

projects.title: Autonomous FPV Drone
projects.shortDescription: Custom-built hexacopter with Arduino & GPS for 1.5km autonomous navigation and real-time FPV video.
projects.description: A fully custom-engineered hexacopter drone built from scratch with Arduino flight controller, GPS module, and 5.8GHz FPV camera system. Achieves 1.5 km operational range with 20-minute flight time and real-time video transmission.
projects.details: Designed and assembled entirely by hand: custom integration of Arduino Mega, u-blox NEO-8M GPS, FlySky FS-i6 RF control system, and 5.8GHz analog FPV transmission. Implements a PID controller for autonomous waypoint navigation. Features live telemetry overlay including GPS coordinates, altitude, battery voltage, and RSSI signal strength. Tested across multiple field missions in Chittagong Division.
